controls.title: Prove deployed identity and database isolation
controls.current_gap: Source fixes are not verified deployment. The queried database still exposes legacy SECURITY DEFINER sync RPCs to PUBLIC; V2 was absent. Advisor warnings need function-by-function review.
controls.implementation: Freeze the actual API/auth images and migrations; verify least-privilege logins, role inheritance, RLS, definer profile/device checks, session revocation, proof-bound lookup and narrow admin powers. Protect hosting, DB, DNS, CI and mail operator accounts with MFA; preserve customer OTP/no-extra-password flow.
controls.acceptance: Security/backend owner: anonymous, guest, wrong account/device, revoked/deleted and narrow-admin tests pass on the actual target; no privileged backend credentials reach clients.

controls.title: Independent recovery and acceptable data loss
controls.current_gap: The approved temporary backup setup has one Mac location and daily copies; off-host/key custody and intended-host recovery remain unaccepted.
controls.implementation: Back up both product and auth databases, original decrypt/lookup keys, lifecycle checkpoint/journals and any object files. Provide independent encrypted copies and separate key custody. Agree server RPO/RTO, prove restore and post-write repair on the intended PostgreSQL target; use supported PITR/continuous recovery where needed.
controls.acceptance: Operations/data owner: a timed loss-of-primary drill meets the agreed recovery point/time and preserves accounts, deletions, financial state and keys. Do not replace the existing bounded Mac schedule without a measured storage plan.

controls.title: Fund and measure hosting, connections and storage
controls.current_gap: User reports free hosting; actual plan/compute/disk allowances are unverified. Live metadata shows max_connections=60 and nine restore-drill databases consuming 211.06 MiB.
controls.implementation: Inventory every host/provider quota and aggregate all pools by physical cluster. Remove no database until its owner, evidence, backup and consumers are verified; move future drills to disposable isolated infrastructure. Reserve measured capacity, cost ceilings and failure headroom before marketing.
controls.acceptance: Infrastructure/database owner: a signed resource budget covers app/auth/workers, provider reserves, database/TOAST/WAL/temp/logs/backup/object growth and burst load; actual measured capacity supports the admitted launch.

controls.title: Quota-approved OTP delivery and abuse/spend limits
controls.current_gap: 100,000 signups can require over 100,000 OTP messages. The actual SMTP/SMS provider quotas, sender readiness and delivery performance are unknown.
controls.implementation: Reserve per-day and peak send capacity; verify sender/domain, production Google sign-in and real canary delivery. Bound bcrypt/verification and recipient/device/IP/global admission before expensive work; test shared-carrier NAT, bots, resend floods, auth-store saturation and provider outages.
controls.acceptance: Auth/delivery owner: target valid signups complete within the OTP lifetime under the approved burst; rejects, bounces, resend costs and blocked legitimate users are measured, with no public test-code bypass.

controls.title: Financial correctness, sync and complete-data migrations
controls.current_gap: The default legacy writer still rejects numeric edits; prepared V2 is off. Historical state/ID reconciliation and concurrent financial edits are not accepted.
controls.implementation: Accept V2 on the exact current protected clone and intended PostgreSQL version, including splits, rewards/caps, private categories, duplicates, stale clocks, simultaneous edits and offline replay. Resolve historical mappings without deletion or identity changes. Either support advertised offline edits correctly or constrain that release flow while retaining drafts.
controls.acceptance: Backend/data owner: balances/projections/history reconcile before and after migration, replay, retries, crashes and concurrency; rejected work remains recoverable. Same-major synthetic tests alone do not close this gate.

controls.title: Bound onboarding fan-out and durable background work
controls.current_gap: Imports can dominate writes; per-instance pools/queues do not establish aggregate capacity. Recovery copies also share the database and have a 50 MiB global source quota.
controls.implementation: Separate sign-in from history/OCR/IMAP/AI work; add durable continuation, idempotent claims/outboxes, bounded request/upload/memory limits, pagination, retry jitter and per-account/global provider budgets. Keep optional recovery/AI/import surfaces off or constrained until their own storage/throughput budgets pass.
controls.acceptance: Backend/worker owner: interruptions, replay and overload neither lose accepted work nor duplicate financial effects; backlog drain time is measured and sign-in stays usable.

controls.title: Signed mobile/client and supply-chain acceptance
controls.current_gap: Normal SQLite/receipt encryption is not integrated. Local unit/debug checks do not establish release-package storage, TLS, permission or upgrade safety.
controls.implementation: Inspect actual signed APK/AAB/IPA/web artifacts and dependencies for secrets/debug endpoints; verify TLS/cleartext, app-private files/secure keys, permission denial, backups, account switching, offline work, updates and key loss. Approve the existing storage baseline or finish the encryption transition before the affected sensitive-data release; keep untested conversion off.
controls.acceptance: Mobile/security owner: the actual supported signed releases pass their data-protection and crash/upgrade matrix, with accurate privacy/recovery claims and no new customer password.

controls.title: Measured load, progressive admission and incident response
controls.current_gap: No production-shaped 100,000/day capacity or independent on-call/alert proof is recorded. Health endpoints are not end-to-end onboarding success.
controls.implementation: Run isolated production-shaped load/failure/soak tests, then a small live canary and staged admission. Add externally monitored signup completion, OTP delivery, pool wait, DB disk/locks, queue age, backup age and cost signals; rehearse pause-new-signup, preserve existing users, rollback/forward repair and operator escalation.
controls.acceptance: Operations/performance owner: the agreed arrival/burst envelope meets recorded targets, including failure mode; offered/admitted/rejected/completed counts are visible and the operator receives test alerts.

controls.title: Privacy, platform and business-policy readiness
controls.current_gap: SMS/background-location permissions and financial data need explicit release review; app-store and OAuth production approval have not been established.
controls.implementation: Approve data inventory, disclosures/consent, retention/deletion/export/support, third-party processing, legal incident duties and age/market scope. Verify Google Play SMS/background-location declarations, store Data Safety/App Privacy and production OAuth configuration. Do not upload unrelated personal SMS.
controls.acceptance: Privacy/product/store owner: launch-date legal/platform applicability and notices are accepted, required permissions are approved and users have a tested manual/permission-denied path.

controls.title: Exact release, migration and edge rollback rehearsal
controls.current_gap: Current source, queried database and deployed API/auth/edge builds are not proven to be the same accepted release.
controls.implementation: Build immutable images off the live host; stage schema before compatible readers/writers; verify TLS/DNS/firewall/proxy trust, private ports and public-cache boundaries. Test readiness/draining, feature flags, canary, config/key availability, compatible rollback and post-write forward repair; do not combine rehosting with mobile/format activation.
controls.acceptance: Release owner: the exact source/config/schema/lock/artifact hashes and signed acceptance record pass the release gate, with a rehearsed operator recovery procedure.
